identification: 8 Tasmanian aluminium number plates, 1960s-80s: WHR 401 (black on white, good), WHR 40? (same series, heavily rusted/peeled), CT-96? (blue on white), ?4416 and ?3599 (blue on white, single plates), TASMANIA-HOLIDAY ISLE 4039 and 5123 (blue on white), and an older grey-on-cream MNC 469 with orange rego tab, heavily corroded. Not the pre-1950s enamel type.
